script = '''
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import openpyxl
import json

# 1. OCR the invoice image
img = Image.open("uploads/invoice.png")
text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

# 2. Split into lines (keep non-empty)
lines = [line for line in text.split("\\n") if line.strip()]

# 3. Create Excel workbook
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice OCR"

# Header
ws["A1"] = "Line"
ws["B1"] = "Extracted Text"
from openpyxl.styles import Font
ws["A1"].font = Font(bold=True)
ws["B1"].font = Font(bold=True)

# Write each line
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=i - 1)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=line)

# Auto-width column B
max_len = max((len(l) for l in lines), default=10)
ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = min(max_len + 2, 100)
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 8

wb.save("invoice_ocr_result.xlsx")

print(f"OCR extracted {len(lines)} lines of text.")
print("--- Extracted Text Preview ---")
for l in lines[:15]:
    print(l)
if len(lines) > 15:
    print(f"... and {len(lines) - 15} more lines")
print("\\nSaved to invoice_ocr_result.xlsx")
'''
await write_file("./ocr_script.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./ocr_script.py")
print(result)

info = await get_file_info("./invoice_ocr_result.xlsx")
print(info)
